name: gmail-operations
description: Gmail API Operations CLI for Claude Code
//overrides: google-auth-library ships OAuth2Client with private fields, so two copies in the tree are structurally incompatible and every google.gmail({auth}) call fails to typecheck. @google-cloud/local-auth still asks for ^9 and googleapis-common pins an exact patch, so collapse the whole tree onto the single version declared above.
//engines: 22.12.0, not 22.0.0: commander 15 is a runtime dependency (src/gmail-operations.ts imports Command) and declares engines.node >=22.12.0. npm only warns on a bad engines field, so a user on 22.0-22.11 would install cleanly and fail in the CLI.
